Acoustic coupling condition for an interval of an optical path.

::: {.note}
Coupling conditions are placed by start distance plus optical_length, the same interval idiom annotations use. Coverage may be partial; optical distance not covered by any coupling condition has undefined coupling, and conditions may not overlap one another. All distances are optical distances.
:::

Aliases: `Coup`, `Coupling`

## Attributes

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `distance` | float | Start optical distance for this coupling condition in meters. |
| `optical_length` | float | Optical path interval length described by this coupling in meters. |
| `coupling_type` | Literal[VALID_COUPLING_TYPES] | Controlled coupling category. Allowed values are conduit, trench, outside_borehole_casing, wireline, surface, coiled, and other. |
| `medium` | str | Surrounding medium, such as soil, rock, or steel. |
| `attachment` | str | Attachment method, such as clamped or bonded. |
| `depth` | float \| None | Depth in meters, positive down, relative to the local surface or deployment reference, when relevant. |
| `notes` | str | Additional notes. |
